description: This Java class 'IndexInitializer' manages the creation and deletion of MongoDB collection indexes using reactive streams and Akka. It initializes indexes, drops undefined ones, and handles index existence checks.

classes.name: IndexInitializer
classes.description: A class responsible for initializing, creating, and dropping indexes on MongoDB collections using reactive streams and Akka.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an IndexInitializer instance with a MongoDatabase and Materializer.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Main method to initialize indexes on a collection: creates missing indexes and drops undefined ones.

methods.name: createNonExistingIndices
methods.description: Creates indexes that do not already exist on the collection.

methods.name: createIndices
methods.description: Creates multiple indexes on a collection.

methods.name: createIndex
methods.description: Creates a single index on a collection.

methods.name: dropUndefinedIndices
methods.description: Drops indexes that are not defined in the current index list.

methods.name: getUndefinedIndexNames
methods.description: Returns names of indexes that are present but not defined.

methods.name: dropIndex
methods.description: Drops a single index by name.

methods.name: getIndicesExceptDefaultIndex
methods.description: Retrieves all indexes except the default '_id_' index.

methods.name: extractIndexNames
methods.description: Extracts index names from a collection of Index objects.

methods.name: excludeIndices
methods.description: Filters out specified indexes from a collection.
